question: Regarding benign prostatic hypertrophy, it is NOT true that:

options.opa: Abdominal ultrasound is a non-invasive method to assess prostate size and post-voiding residual.
options.opb: It can cause increases in PSA levels.
options.opc: Rectal examination is a method to estimate prostate size.
options.opd: Treatment with 5-alpha reductase inhibitors decreases symptoms.

analysis: Benign prostatic hypertrophy is not a precancerous lesion, but rather a non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate gland. It is a common condition in older men and can cause urinary symptoms due to the enlarged prostate pressing on the urethra.
